currentSprint.name: Recents carousel on homepage
currentSprint.progress: Sprint S11 100% completed: Implemented client-side recently used tools row/carousel on homepages (EN, ES, DA). 1) Canonical ring buffer in localStorage['ac:recents'] storing up to 8 uniquely visited tools keyed strictly by canonical slug (/slug/), with automatic promotion of repeated tools to index 0 and eviction of the 9th oldest tool. 2) Tool layout detection (.tool-wrapper, .tool-card, .tool-container, .tool-zone, .dc-root) records tool visits automatically upon user arrival. 3) Dynamic hydration on /, /es/, and /da/ renders #dash-recents-section directly above Quick Access, staying completely hidden when empty (0 CLS, 0 placeholders). 4) Localized titles and clear buttons across EN ('Recently Used' / 'Clear recents'), ES ('Usado recientemente' / 'Borrar recientes'), and DA ('Senest brugte' / 'Ryd seneste'). 5) Accessible WCAG 2.2 AA ARIA semantics (section aria-labelledby, nav aria-label, clear button aria-label) and high-contrast :focus-visible rules for .dash-recent-card and .dash-recents-clear-btn (2px solid #B04A45, 2px offset). 6) Keyboard support on clear action (Enter / Space). 7) window.ACAnalytics telemetry for recent_clicked and recents_cleared, plus ac:recents-updated CustomEvent dispatch. Built tests/test_s11_recents_carousel.js (15/15 passing). All 26 master test suites passed (26/26 PASS, 100%). Pre-deploy release gate report G1-G15 recorded in docs/growth/91-TEST-EVIDENCE-AND-RELEASE-GATES.md and ADR-050 recorded in .ai-memory/DECISIONS.md.
